description_expanded: This upscale four-bedroom vacation home in Dune Allen Beach can comfortably sleep up to 15 fortunate beach-going guests with multiple beds. Its outstanding location is close to Stallworth Lake and the shimmering shoreline. This coastal dune lake is a natural treasure, the likes of which are found hardly anywhere else on the planet. A creek-like tributary connects to the open gulf creating a magical mixture of artisan spring-fed and salted waters. This exotic habitat supports abundant wildlife, waterfowl, and a wide variety of fish. Guests enjoy exploring the lovely lake by paddleboard or kayak and trying their luck fishing. Seven Palms sits next to a beautiful remote stretch of shoreline that extends three miles west beside towering dunes at the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park . Besides the beach and precious lake, this 30A vacation home features a 30'x12' private swimming pool for refreshing fun. A spillover spa on one corner cascades down into the pool beside it. This is the perfect place to relax during the cooler times of the year as this home offers complimentary pool heat. The grounds include far more than “seven palms,” providing a gorgeous tropical setting. Turfgrass and lovely landscapes line the side of the home, which leads to a three-hole miniature golf putt-putt course and patio. A covered furnished patio overlooks this lush setting to enjoy drinks poolside. Indoors, a spacious first-floor den includes a full-sized refrigerator freezer, a sectional sofa, a large flatscreen TV, and a game table making entertainment a breeze. Guest quarters here have access to a convenient full bath with a tub shower combination. One of these quarters is in the open living area with a king-sized bed and a twin daybed which are separated by a floor to ceiling drapery to create a cozy sleeping environment. The other is a bunk room for the kids with two full/twin bunk beds. This provides a perfect separate setting for those sharing a 30A beach vacation. The main open living, dining, and kitchen areas are upstairs and additional guest quarters. This bright, spacious area features an entire wall of windows with sliding glass doors that lead out to an upper wraparound balcony. It includes a gas grill, a dining table, and comfortable furnishings overlooking the pool. The interior living space features a modern sectional with rustic accents, making the room comfortable and inviting. A giant flatscreen TV mounted above a floating credenza allows for guests’ viewing pleasure. Additional seating is provided beside the windows and focuses on the beautiful view. The chic dining area includes a rustic modern dining table with upholstered benches to provide ample seating. The large open state-of-the-art kitchen features brushed stainless steel appliances, dark-colored contemporary cabinetry, white quartz countertops, a large island with seating, and a wet bar with a wine cooler. The spacious master bedroom features a king-sized bed with a modern leather headboard, a large flat screen tv, and a cozy lounge chair. Glass doors lead to the attached sitting area near the living quarters. The ensuite luxury master bath features double vanity sinks, a soaking tub, and a glass-walled walk-in shower. The two guest bedrooms on this floor are equipped with a king and queen bed and comfortable contemporary furnishings. They share a full hall bath with double vanities and a tub shower combination. This fantastic Dune Allen Beach locale is close to great restaurants, friendly beach bars, grocery stores, and shopping adventures. The popular Santa Rosa Beach village center of Gulf Place is nearby with dining establishments, shopping excursions, and an amphitheater that hosts open-air concerts. First Floor: Bonus Den with King Bed and Twin Daybed, Bunk Room with Two Full/Twin Bunks, Hall Bath with Tub/Shower Combo. Second Floor: Living Room with Balcony Access, Kitchen, Dining, King Master Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub + Sitting Room, King Bedroom, Hall Bath with Tub/Shower Combo, Queen Bedroom, Laundry. Rates reflect a discount for nearby construction.
